summary: The revision-2026-09-22.11 bridge sup_b ||p_{Q3|Q_rest=b}||_infinity <= C is false even for iid Uniform[0,1] in n=4 and A_tau=I-(1-tau)J/4 with spectrum {1,1,1,tau}. For b=tau s^2, s->2-, the conditioned product slice is a simplex of diameter r=2(2-s), Q3 is supported in an interval of length <=3r^2/4, so every conditional density has sup at least 4/(3r^2)->infinity. This is not a QFORM counterexample: the completed account03/B12 two-same-sign physical-three-block theorem gives the full law density <=24.183038289961516 for every real tau. Any scalar-conditioning proof must retain Q_rest level weights inside averaging and cannot take the worst fiber first.
